items.title: Submit proof of use of Bauspar loan funds (heating company invoice or signed order)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie den Nachweis binnen 10 Arbeitstagen nach dem Briefdatum ein.
items.computation: The letter is dated Saturday 21.11.2026 and this is a company (not an authority), so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the period runs from the letter's own date. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (21.11.2026) is not counted, so counting starts 22.11.2026 (Sunday). Counting 10 Arbeitstage (business days, Mon-Fri, excluding public holidays per § 193 BGB) from there: Mon 23.11, Tue 24.11, Wed 25.11, Thu 26.11, Fri 27.11 (5), Mon 30.11, Tue 01.12, Wed 02.12, Thu 03.12, Fri 04.12 (10th business day). No public holidays fall in this window in NW or Hessen, so the deadline stays Friday 04.12.2026.

warnings: If the proof does not arrive in time, the letter states the loan payout is simply postponed to the next first-of-the-month, not that the contract or deadline can be ignored; no scam indicators were found but the IBAN belongs to a third-party bank (Musterbank AG) rather than the sender itself, which is normal for a Bausparkasse but worth confirming if any payment to this account is ever requested.
